known_limitations: commit_sha is null in this handoff because the handoff is committed inside the lane's single commit (a hash cannot contain itself); the commit sha is reported in the lane's final chat message and verifiable via git log on orca/jrv1-lane-ts.

No TYPESAFE_API_KEY exists in this lane (per dispatch), so the live provider path is implemented but NEVER exercised against the real API: every provider interaction is tested via injected fetch (TypeSafeClient config.fetch) or --mock. All 57 tests are network-free by construction (child adapter runs have TYPESAFE_API_KEY stripped from env in test/helpers.ts).

freezes/model_pin.json currently has pinned_model null (status CANDIDATE_UNVERIFIED): every live CLI run exits 3 BLOCKED_MODEL_PIN by design until the Lead's G0 canary freeze act fills the pin. The missing-pin refusal test self-skips once the pin is filled (the jev-latest refusal test then remains the pin-law guard).

Provider-error response rows carry no regime field (the dispatch enumerates error rows as {status, error_class, input_digest, latency_ms, request_id?}); consumers map any non-OK status to TRANSITION_UNKNOWN per the persistence_contract error law. plan §5 wording ('=> TRANSITION_UNKNOWN with status') is implemented at the consumer boundary, not by fabricating a regime on error rows.

models_probe.ts writes its probe output to adapter/runtime/models_probe.json (gitignored) because this lane's allowed paths exclude the control-level runtime/ directory; the Lead may relocate the artifact at G0. Probe accepts --out for relocation.

input_digest equality with the Python side requires the Python canonical_json to be json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) on the same parsed state; for all fixture-representable numeric values the RFC 8259 number serializations of JSON.stringify and Python's repr-based float formatting agree. Exotic exponent formats were not cross-validated (no lane-py contract available to this lane).

Cache-entry request_sha256/response_sha256 are informational integrity hashes over JSON.stringify serialization (insertion order); the authoritative cache key is the frozen sha256(model||state_id||input_digest), which is order-independent by construction.

The --mock classifier is a PLAUSIBILITY heuristic aligned with freezes/synthetic_canary_fixtures.json (all five sendable fixtures classify within their frozen acceptable sets); it is not a model and makes no predictive claim. Mock canaries validate plumbing only (P-15 kill-only law).
